decision: Approved after inspection of all 192 source/HTML comparison sheets at the canonical source-page aspect ratio.
authorized_exceptions: The repeating green/orange running header and footer decoration is removed on every page as requested.
InDesign filenames, timestamps, crop marks, and duplicate folio text are removed.
The printed folio remains visibly centered on every page and is aria-hidden to avoid duplicate narration.
Text-bearing artwork is replaced by or paired with live semantic HTML where required for complete read-aloud and yellow word highlighting.
